meta.title: End-to-End Order Flow Validation
meta.epic: 10 - Live Trading Production Readiness & Lighter.xyz Integration

story-context.story-summary: Validate the complete order flow from strategy signal to position update, confirming the entire trading pipeline works correctly.

acceptance-criteria.criterion: Complete BUY signal flow validated (signal → executor → order → broker → fill → position)
Complete SELL signal flow validated (position closed, PnL calculated)
Timing meets NFR1: signal to API call less than 100ms (excluding network)
Flow works across session restarts (persist, restart, continue)
All components exercised: Engine → StrategyExecutor → OrderManager → Broker → Fill → StateManager

key-tasks.task: Create end-to-end test infrastructure with timing instrumentation
Implement BUY flow test (signal → order → fill → position)
Implement SELL flow test (close position, verify PnL)
Implement timing measurement (signal to API call latency)
Implement restart test (persist, restart, continue trading)
Trace component chain (add trace logging, verify sequence)
Test multiple BUY/SELL cycles for consistency

architecture-context.pattern: 1. LiveTradingEngine.run() 2. StrategyExecutor.on_bar(bar_data) → generates signal 3. OrderManager.create_order(signal) 4. BrokerAdapter.submit_order(order) 5. BrokerAdapter receives fill (stream or poll) 6. OrderManager.on_fill(fill) 7. StateManager.update_position(fill) 8. Position updated, PnL recalculated
architecture-context.constraint: Signal to API call latency less than 100ms (NFR1)
All state transitions logged for audit (NFR10)

dependencies.dependency: Full live trading engine on testnet

nfr-references.nfr: Exact position state recovery after restart
